capability.name: AIF Electrical
capability.description: Validates electrical metadata and connection points for AIF AC-powered equipment (CDU, CRAH, UPS).

requirements.name: nominal-voltage-required
requirements.message: AC-powered equipment must declare its nominal input voltage.

requirements.name: power-rating-required
requirements.message: AC-powered equipment must declare its power rating.

requirements.name: electrical-frequency-required
requirements.message: AC-powered equipment must declare its input frequency.

requirements.name: electrical-connection-points
requirements.message: Equipment with electrical connections must have *_electrical_nominal_voltage_* connection point prims.
